reply_text:
I answered Marcus in his DM: on 14 October he told me his standing call with Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thursdays at 16:30**, starting that week. I checked this against his original message in the same DM, and it matches what I saved in memory.

I didn't change his calendar. I offered to add the call as a recurring event if he wants. The fact came from his own DM, so it was fine to tell him, and I haven't shared it anywhere else.
